error.localSave: Couldn’t save on this device. Try again.

errorCode.hetzner_create_uncertain: Hetzner may have created the server {{server}}. Check the Hetzner Cloud Console before you try again.
errorCode.hetzner_provision_pending: The server {{name}} wasn’t finished. Resume or delete it before you create another.
errorCode.hetzner_host_key_replacement: The new server {{name}} presented a different SSH host key than expected. Don’t continue unless you can confirm the key in the Hetzner Cloud Console.
errorCode.install_phase_failed: A step on the VPS failed.
errorCode.install_ssh_failed: Couldn’t sign in to the VPS over SSH. Check the host key and the login. Nothing on the VPS was changed.
errorCode.install_incompatible: This VPS can’t be used: it’s incompatible or already runs another installation. Nothing on the VPS was changed.
errorCode.invitation_expired: This join code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errorCode.invitation_used: This join code was already used or cancelled. Ask for a new one.
errorCode.invitation_invalid: This join code isn’t valid. Check it and try again.
errorCode.port_forward_public_port: That public port is reserved, already in use or not valid. Choose another one.
errorCode.operation_in_progress: Another change to this server is running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errorCode.install_outcome_unknown: The outcome on {{host}} is unknown: the VPS may have applied the change, but its confirmation was lost. This device kept its keys. Check the change again when the VPS is reachable.
errorCode.install_rolled_back: The VPS rolled the change back, so nothing changed.
errorCode.person_has_join_codes: This person still has device join codes. Cancel them first.
errorCode.person_name_taken: Another person on this server already uses this name. Choose a different name.
errorCode.transaction_unresolved: An earlier change to {{host}} from this device is unresolved. Resolve it, or forget it, before starting another.
errorCode.release_rate_limited: GitHub is limiting update checks from your network. Try again in an hour, or use a custom source.
errorCode.release_offline: Couldn’t reach the release source. Check your internet connection and try again.
errorCode.android_install_permission: Allow SirinVPN to install apps in the Android settings that opened, then tap Install update again.
errorCode.release_none: GitHub has no published release for this channel yet. Try the other channel, or check again later.

maintenanceBlocker.not_owner: only the Owner device can maintain this VPS
maintenanceBlocker.persistent_policy: turn off the kill switch and auto-reconnect first
maintenanceBlocker.pending_key_rotation: finish or recover this device’s pending key rotation first
maintenanceBlocker.unresolved_transaction: resolve the interrupted VPS change first
